meaning:
κατα-κρημνίζω
(κρημνός), [in LXX: 2Ch.25:12 (שָׁלַךְ hi.), 2Ma.12:15 2Mac 14:43, 4Ma.4:25*.]
to throw over a precipice, cast down head­long: Luk.4:29.†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: to throw Him over the cliff

elsewhere.note: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
